sections.title: What you get from the consultation

items.label: An audit of your site's technical health, content and authority.
A priority list ranked by impact and effort.
A roadmap for the coming months, with clear phases.
A walkthrough session with your team to discuss the plan and answer questions.
Defined KPIs and a baseline to measure against.
Regular progress reviews and updated priorities.

items.question: What's the difference between SEO consulting and a full SEO project?
items.answer: Consulting gives your team the diagnosis, priorities and roadmap, while a full SEO project includes ongoing implementation on your site.

items.question: Do you work with in-house marketing teams?
items.answer: Yes. We handle the analysis and set the priorities, and your team implements them, with regular follow-up and reviews from us.

items.question: What do you need to get started?
items.answer: Read access to Search Console and Google Analytics, an understanding of your business goals, and the dates of any major changes to the site.

items.question: Can you review another agency's work?
items.answer: Yes. We give an independent assessment of what has been done and what is being proposed, with no obligation to switch to us.

items.question: Does consulting cover sudden traffic drops?
items.answer: Yes. We start by pinpointing when the drop happened and which changes or updates coincided with it before recommending any action.

items.question: Does it include a site migration plan?
items.answer: Yes. We plan redirects, URL structure and measurement before the migration, and monitor indexing afterward.
